subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic server-side compaction be exposed as a focused compaction config on Anthropic models, as part of a broader Anthropic `context_management` passthrough, or deferred out of core for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the public config/API shape and how it overlaps #54041 is a maintainer product/API decision rather than a safe autonomous cleanup.

options.title: Focused opt-in compaction
options.body: Add a narrow Anthropic-only compaction surface that preserves existing local compaction defaults and handles the full request/stream/replay contract.

options.title: Broader context-management passthrough
options.body: Use #54041 as the canonical design and expose compaction together with memory/context-editing provider features.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Keep local compaction as the supported path until a plugin/API seam can expose Anthropic-native context management without expanding core config.

recommendation.title: Focused opt-in compaction
recommendation.body: Add a narrow Anthropic-only compaction surface that preserves existing local compaction defaults and handles the full request/stream/replay contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the closest combined history across the OpenAI compaction precedent, Anthropic wrapper/docs context, and prior maintainer review on this issue.
